messages:
maria: Quick sync — sprint aim is to finish v2 dep lifecycle for the public API routes. We need: 1) SDK compatibility signoff, 2) PR triage for schema pinning, 3) canary window reserved. @ash @kevin can you status the SDK and runtime work?
ash: SDK side: v2 client changes are in two PRs (https://github.com/redwood/sdk/pull/498, https://github.com/redwood/sdk/pull/501). 498 is green but needs docs update; 501 has a flaky test on CI (encoding edgecase). Trying to get that fixed today.
kevin: Runtime side: v2 route mapping is behind a feature flag on dev; I have a branch that folds the shim but it needs one more review. I can submit a hotfix for the KV cache behavior if 501 lands.
lina: I can take the runtime review. Please add the label "v2-compat-review" and tag me.
ash: Thanks @lina — will add label. For SDK docs: short snippet change — can someone from devex confirm wording? Jenna?
jenna: I can do a quick docs pass. ETA today EOD. Also, billing needs a heads-up about token-metering changes; that'll affect the dedicated pricing page.
maria: Noted @jenna — can you ping @finance once docs are updated so they can validate pricing copy?
jenna: Yep — will ping.
sre-oncall: Heads-up: canary slot tomorrow 09:00-10:30 PST. We need smoke tests and a rollback plan. Also want a brief load test (10m) during the slot to validate latency.
kevin: Can we do smoke steps like: 
```
# smoke script
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY' https://api.staging.redwood.ai/v2/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'
```
Add a second call to exercise streaming.
ash: Good. I'll add smoke scripts to the PR and a small checklist in the PR description.
deploy-bot: deploy created: v2-canary/2623456 scheduled for 2026-03-18T09:00:00Z by @maria (status: pending) :rocket:
maria: Action items recap: 1) @ash fix flaky test and land SDK PRs (target: today), 2) @kevin open runtime hotfix PR and tag @lina for review (target: today morning), 3) @jenna docs + finance ping (target: EOD), 4) @sre-oncall run canary + 10m load test tomorrow slot.
kevin: One dependency note — the edge-case KV change touches a shared util used by dedupe service. I filed a dependency issue: https://github.com/redwood/platform/issues/7245. If dedupe needs a quick patch, that could add 1-2 dev days.
ash: Ok noted. Can we isolate with a feature flag to avoid immediate cross-service rollout?
kevin: Yes, we'll gate it behind `feature.v2_kv_compat`. That should minimize blast radius.
lina: I'll prioritize the review and check for any dedupe breakage locally. If I see issues, I'll post a follow-up in this thread.
maria: If all goes green, we'll proceed with canary and then a staged 3-wave rollout (5%, 25%, 100%) over 48 hours. If dedupe shows problems, rollback plan = immediate flag toggle + redeploy previous runtime image.
jenna: Finance ping scheduled once docs merged. Also adding a tiny blurb for customers about SDK changes to help PLG flows.
sre-oncall: Please add tracing hooks for the canary so we can correlate tail-latency. Also ensure the canary has the fallback policy to older model variants if latency spikes.
maria: Good call — @kevin @ash please include those flags in the canary config.
kevin: Will do.
ash: I'll update SDK to send the new trace-id header as part of the smoke tests.
maria: Anything else? If not, I'll convert this into a small checklist in the migration board and assign owners. :white_check_mark:
kevin: Nothing else from me, thanks everyone.
lina: If review finishes early I'll post a short summary here.
maria: Thanks — we'll reconvene async.
(END)
